title: Franklin D. Roosevelt
summary: Franklin D. Roosevelt (1882-1945), born at Hyde Park, New York, was left paralysed in the legs by polio in 1921 but became governor of New York and, in 1933, the 32nd US president. His New Deal reformed banking, gave unions the right to bargain collectively and created Social Security, though only war mobilisation ended the Great Depression. He sent massive aid to Britain, led the country into the Second World War after Pearl Harbor, and died in April 1945, weeks before Germany surrendered.
